study.question: Does retaining advertisement/category/brand identity in within-block target-match/value covariance improve click ranking beyond the current averaged summary, and does that benefit depend on task-specific residual decoding?
study.hypothesis: The incumbent averages three binary target matches before its value contraction. Linearity implies that field-specific covariances are reduced to their mean, making distinct matching patterns indistinguishable. Retaining three covariances may preserve complementary target-conditioned information that task-specific adapters exploit better than shared adapters. This is a local hypothesis, not an originality claim or an inference that earlier gains established a mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: Direct parent uses one mean of three match/value covariances, plus three counts and task-specific adapters. New candidate keeps three covariance channels; matched replacements repeat the old mean into the same wider input.

Archived primary text lines255-282 describes candidate-dependent unnormalized local-activation pooling. We inherit its adapted scorer, but append deterministic field-specific within-block centered match/value statistics to compressed UF readouts; no exact DIN reproduction claim.

Pinned benchmark lines194-274 uses fixed and feature-derived queries with heterogeneous attention. This proposal has no learned query compression, heterogeneous attention or token mixer: three deterministic covariance channels feed small zero-initialized adapters. Benchmark inspection does not verify the original HeMix paper.

Only the archived author README was read; it warns that its history has category/brand/action but no item. This benchmark supplies previous advertisement IDs. No DMR full-paper mechanism, reproduction or priority claim is made.
Registry verifies the task-aware information-flow paper link only. Full text has not been audited; this is an unresolved nearest-work check, not evidence of originality.

inherited_components: g0-r0009-match_detail_task: FeatureEmbeddingDict, action-aware DIN scorer, 30-slot UF compression and four Dice towers
Same auxiliary scorer and item/action stop-gradients, context gradients and cloned auxiliary buffers
Same item/category/brand equality checks excluding zero and declared padding/OOV IDs; three log1p counts
Four residual adapters of hidden width16, zero output layers, history-presence gate and task/shared bank routing
study.proposed_difference: For field f and temporal block b compute C_f = sum_b sum_i [m_if - valid_i*sum_j(m_jf)/max(n_b,1)] v_i / sqrt(max(total_valid,1)). Concatenate [C_item/3,C_category/3,C_brand/3]. The equal-capacity replacement concatenates [C_mean/3,C_mean/3,C_mean/3], where C_mean=(C_item+C_category+C_brand)/3. Both channel sums equal the original mean statistic in exact arithmetic. Cross separated versus repeated-mean information with task versus shared adapter routing. All four cells compute every C_f and the repeated mean before choosing the input. Adapter input grows by2*value_width, with no change to scorer/tower populations. The original parent is an external comparison, not a capacity-matched control.
